Day 26 (old art) - March 2016 (age 13)

a self portrait I drew back in the day to celebrate my first skateboard

which I never actually used cause it was terrible and I was terrified

I did skate for a while when I was 17-18 tho and I still kinda wanna go back to it but with how shaky my joints are it's just so scary to fall •3•;
